title: StoryInput
description: A single video idea before it has been broken into scenes. English viewer-facing fields only.

title.description: Working title. Viewer-facing (may be refined for the real upload title later).

language.description: Viewer-facing language. Always English per channel policy.

hook.description: The opening idea/question the video hooks on.

source.description: Named study/phenomenon this claim is attributable to. Optional but recommended per CORE-CREATIVE-PROMPT.md content rules.

target_length_seconds.description: A target only — final timing always comes from measured audio (see TECHNICAL-SPEC-EN.md section 7), never from this field.

tone.description: Feeds COLOR_ANCHOR wording choice; 'tense'/'somber' are the documented case where COLOR_ANCHOR's warm-flattening tradeoff should be reconsidered.

content_safety_notes.description: Free-text notes for sensitive real-world references requiring an abstracted visual treatment (see CORE-CREATIVE-PROMPT.md).

role_outfit_ref.description: id of the role-outfit record to use for character identity lock. Defaults to the channel's single canonical record if omitted.
